summary: VersaBank filed a Form S-4 registration statement with the SEC for a proposed corporate reorganization to realign its structure under a U.S. bank holding company, Versa Bancorp, a new Delaware corporation. The plan will make Versa Bancorp the parent of VersaBank and VersaBank USA N.A. No specific financial terms are disclosed. The filing is a milestone toward seeking shareholder and regulatory approvals from OSFI, Canadian Ministry of Finance, and the U.S. Federal Reserve. Watch for shareholder vote timing and regulatory clearance; index inclusion and U.S. reporting are key motivations.
